episode_summary: In this episode, Michael Opyd coaches Emma Noon through overcoming personal loss and regaining her motivation in real estate. They discuss the importance of maintaining consistent routines, focusing on a strong 'why', and making mindset shifts to improve performance. Listeners will gain actionable insights into how to navigate personal challenges while sustaining professional success.
